player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} ulelenga icheza game ya Pig Dice.

Mikwamo:
- Pa nshiku yako, ungashininkisha ama '[roll]' kapena '[hold]'
- Shininkisha 2-6: Ongeza kwa jumla ya nshiku yako
- Shininkisha 1: Lasa jumla ya nshiku yako na maliza nshiku
- Hold: Ongeza jumla ya nshiku yako kwa alama zako na maliza nshiku
- Wa kwanza kufikia {winning_score} alama akawina

Pa nshiku yako, ukalaba alama zilizo na jumla ya nshiku.
Iyambe na '[roll]' ukashininkisha die kapena '[hold]' ukaweka alama zako.
